brief_problem: The inventory for the school page

runs.text: JSON is a way of writing data as text that any program knows how to read.
The problem
The school has a page that shows the kiosk inventory, but it cannot read
juice;10
: it expects
JSON
. The five products with their stock have to be
exported
How do you write the inventory so that another program understands it, and how do you check that it came out right?
Try it
Write by hand the JSON of two products: juice with 10 and sandwich with 5.
. The braces enclose the object; each key goes between double quotes, followed by a colon and its value; the entries are separated by commas.
Understand and plan

entries.text: What goes in and what comes out?
The stock of the five products goes in; out comes a text that the school page knows how to read.
of the previous lesson, with other writing rules.
What can fail outside the program?
The text that arrives from outside can be broken.

runs.text: The new tool
JSON
writes data as text with objects between braces, lists between brackets, numbers, texts between quotes and logical values. Almost every program knows how to read it.

runs.text: What you learned

points.text: JSON writes data as text with objects, lists, numbers and texts; almost every program reads it.
Serializing is turning a datum into text to save it or send it, and being able to rebuild it.

runs.text: Practise

entries.text: JSON only accepts double quotes; the single ones belong to the program that builds it.
It is the most common error, and
marks it with line and column.
Believing that JSON is a kind of file.
It is a way of writing text: it can go in a file, in a message or in an answer from the internet.
